currentReviewPath.surface: Windows desktop browser CAD upload-to-preview path
currentReviewPath.expectedEntry: Email link -> production browser preview -> Choose CAD file
currentReviewPath.expectedResult: local 3D preview with dimensions, grid, zoom and orientation controls
currentReviewPath.secondaryPath: installed Android internal preview remains internal fallback context only

sentCorrectionEmail.subject: Updated ReversR CAD preview: please test in Windows browser first
sentCorrectionEmail.bodySummary: Ask Mark to open the production browser preview on Windows, choose an authorized .igs or .iges file, render the preview, validate dimensions/grid/zoom/orientation controls, and report browser/file/screenshot details if anything fails.
sentCorrectionEmail.knownLimitationsDisclosure: This is still an internal preview; production upload, backend conversion, manufacturing/export output and private CAD workflows are not enabled.

mustShow: draft email view with exact link
select public authorized Dispenser.IGS fixture for the demonstration

markApprovalRequiredFor: claims that the CAD preview is externally validated

minimumFields: screenshot or short clip when possible

triageClasses.defaultAction: confirm URL, browser and production deployment before changing source
capture Windows/browser/file details and reproduce with public or synthetic file before changing backend gates
treat as local renderer/file compatibility issue; do not infer backend upload or conversion failure
route to source/fixture interpretation review and keep external validation claims blocked
answer from remaining-gates list; do not imply production activation or commercialization readiness

responseRules: do not ask Mark for private CAD in this review path
do not request production credentials or account enrollment
do not claim a backend upload, conversion or Sandbox failure from a local preview symptom
preserve direct recipient details as local/email evidence references rather than source text

markApprovalNotRequiredFor: public preview hardening that preserves current disabled gates
upload/session UX clarity while upload admission remains disabled
feedback intake and triage packet updates
browser tester diagnostics and support-readiness updates

parallelWorkAllowed.description: Keep the public-material preview usable and clear while Mark reviews it.
limits: public or explicitly authorized materials only

parallelWorkAllowed.description: Improve disabled upload/session language and recovery paths without activating uploads.
Prepare per-CAD-run cost breakdown planning across Convex, Vercel, Sandbox, storage, compute and contingency.

hardStops: provider/auth/resource/env changes outside the approved development target
new paid commitments at or above the approved cap
external messages beyond the completed approved Mark correction send
claims that Mark approved geometry before his response is received
nextRecommendedGate: continue non-conflicting internal readiness work while Mark feedback remains pending
